<thought>We need a single-step retrosynthesis that converts the target methyl ester into its corresponding carboxylic acid and methanol. This is a common esterification (forward: acid + MeOH → ester). We'll search for a template that forms an ester (functional group formed: ester) and breaks a carboxylic acid. Then we’ll verify that the acid precursor is commercially available and within budget.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ester"],
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic_acid"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
